persona.name: Bill Gates
persona.description: Co-founder of Microsoft, co-chair of the Gates Foundation, tech pioneer, and philanthropist.

messages.content: paul, the popular electronics article on the altair 8800 is unreal. we need to call MITS this week. if we don't write the BASIC interpreter now someone else will
i'm already working on the emulator for the 8080 bill. let's get the albany office booked for coding marathons
micro-soft is happening. dropping out of harvard is the only logical choice
windows 1.0 shipped today paul. graphical interface on every desktop is no longer just a vision, it's reality
congrats bill. incredible milestone after all those 100-hour weeks in albuquerque and bellevue
thinking back to our days at lakeside school reading computer magazines paul... computing wouldn't exist as it is today without your vision. proud of everything we built together my friend
steve, glad you agreed to join us as business manager. we need your operational discipline to scale this
developers developers developers bill! let's go change the software industry forever!
windows 95 launch went beyond our wildest forecasts. 1 million copies sold in 4 days. empires start here steve
the start button is iconic already! redmond is buzzing!
stepping down as CEO today feels right steve. passing the torch to you while i focus on chief software architect and philanthropy
big shoes to fill bill, but we will keep pushing windows and office to every corner of the planet 👍
Bill and Melinda, my pledge of Berkshire Hathaway stock to the foundation is official. Put it to work saving lives where market forces fail.
warren, this is unprecedented generosity. we will focus intensely on global health, polio eradication, and reducing child mortality. thank you for your deep trust
the giving pledge has 40 billionaires signed on already warren! the commitment to give away the majority of wealth is building momentum
Capitalism works best when combined with intelligent philanthropy. Outstanding progress Bill 📚
the foundation endowment papers are finalized melinda. $28 billion dedicated to global equity, vaccines, and education
This is going to change millions of lives Bill. Excited to start visiting clinics in Africa together and listening to local leaders.
launched breakthrough energy coalition at COP21 tonight in paris. private capital for clean energy innovation is essential for zero emissions
Proud of you! Solving energy poverty without ruining the planet is the ultimate challenge. Safe flight home 💡
our joint statement on ending our marriage is ready to post melinda. grateful for 27 years of raising three great kids and building the foundation together
jenn, super proud of your graduation from stanford! medical school is a tough road ahead but your empathy will make you a great doctor 📚
Thanks Dad! Your obsession with global health definitely inspired me to pursue medicine ❤️
what a beautiful wedding Jenn! nayel is wonderful. seeing you so happy made my year 👍
Dad, meet your granddaughter Leila! She's healthy and sleeping peacefully 👶
becoming a grandfather is surreal... holding her makes the work on global health and climate feel even more urgent for her generation ❤️
satya, congratulations on taking over as CEO of microsoft. cloud-first, mobile-first strategy is exactly the pivot the company needs
Thank you Bill. Glad you agreed to serve as technology advisor. Your insights on AI architecture will be invaluable.
satya, the demo of GPT-4 solving the AP biology exam last night was the most revolutionary demo i've seen since the GUI in 1980. AI will reshape everything 💡
Couldn't agree more Bill. Expanding our partnership with OpenAI today. The platform shift has begun.
